component.name: EPGScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.playlistId = "" m.top.onProgramSelect = invalid m.top.onBack = false m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") m.programGrid = m.top.findNode("programGrid") m.programGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onProgramSelected") end sub
sub loadEPG(playlistId as string) m.top.playlistId = playlistId result = syncPlaylists(0) if result.ok channels = [] programs = [] for each playlist in result.data.playlists if playlist.id = playlistId or playlistId = "" for each channel in playlist.channels ? [] channels.push({ title: channel.name, id: channel.id }) for each prog in channel.programs ? [] programs.push({ channelId: channel.id, title: prog.title, start: prog.start, stop: prog.stop }) end for end for end if end for m.channelList.content = buildListContent(channels) m.programGrid.content = buildGridContent(programs) end if end sub
sub onProgramSelected() idx = m.programGrid.itemSelected if idx >= 0 item = m.programGrid.content.getChild(idx) m.top.onProgramSelect = { title: item.title, channelId: item.channelId } end if end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) if key = 283 m.top.onBack = true end if end sub
